mapper.select: select suf.*, su.username, sg.good_name, sg.image, sg.good_info, sg.price from store_user_footmark suf join store_user su on suf.user_id = su.user_id join store_good sg on suf.good_id = sg.good_id where (#{storeUserCollectQuery.username} is null or su.username like concat('%', #{storeUserCollectQuery.username}, '%')) and (#{storeUserCollectQuery.goodName} is null or sg.good_name like concat('%', #{storeUserCollectQuery.goodName}, '%')) and (#{storeUserCollectQuery.startprice} is null or sg.price >= #{storeUserCollectQuery.startprice}) and (#{storeUserCollectQuery.endprice} is null or sg.price <= #{storeUserCollectQuery.endprice}) and (#{storeUserCollectQuery.starttime} is null or suf.create_time >= #{storeUserCollectQuery.starttime}) and (#{storeUserCollectQuery.endtime} is null or suf.create_time <= #{storeUserCollectQuery.endtime})
